(()=>{if(!window.__limitRequests?.length)throw Error('No live request');for(const r of window.__limitRequests){if(r.execution.maxRounds!==128||r.execution.maxToolCalls!==512||r.execution.maxOutputTokens!==32768||r.execution.timeoutMs!==300000)throw Error(JSON.stringify(r));}return {requests:window.__limitRequests,panel:document.querySelector('[aria-label="Drawing assistant panel"]').innerText};})()
